name: student-draft-to-feedback
title: A student drafts, submits, and reads real feedback
audience: Teachers and curriculum leads who want to see the student side before adopting
goal: Show the student writing experience and that feedback comes back as coaching, not just a score.

scenes.narration: A student opens YAWP! and sees the writing that is actually due.
Opening an assignment drops them straight into the draft, where they left off.
The editor is plain and quiet. Nothing to configure, nothing to install.

steps.text: Whitman's barbaric yawp is not noise. It is a claim that an ordinary voice deserves to be heard.
Work saves as they type, so a dead laptop battery does not cost them a draft.

scenes.narration: Once the teacher releases grades, the student sees the score and the reasoning behind it.

steps.text: Rubric scores, an overall comment, and notes on the lines themselves.

scenes.narration: That is the point. Students get coached on the writing, not just scored on it.
